_readme: المنشور الصيني الملزم: أسماء المعالم والمسارات تُكتب بصيغتها هنا حرفاً. الخلاصات (summary_zh) تُعرض في الصفحة نفسها بجوار نصوص الدفعة.

jabal-al-qarah.title: جبل القارة
jabal-al-qarah.summary_en: Caves that stay cool in summer and warm in winter, carved by time at the heart of the oasis.
jabal-al-qarah.summary_zh: 绿洲深处，岁月凿出的洞穴——盛夏藏凉，寒冬存暖，是酷暑行程中清凉舒适的一站。

qasr-ibrahim.title: قصر إبراهيم
qasr-ibrahim.summary_en: Mud walls and palm-trunk roofs in a fortress that gathers mosque, barracks and towers.
qasr-ibrahim.summary_zh: 泥墙筑就、椰枣树干盖顶的城堡里，清真寺、军营与瞭望塔比邻而立。

jawatha-mosque.title: مسجد جواثا
jawatha-mosque.summary_en: One of the oldest mosques in Islam, and the first place a Friday prayer was held after Medina.
jawatha-mosque.summary_zh: 伊斯兰历史上最古老的清真寺之一，也是继麦地那之后最早举行主麻日聚礼的地方。

asfar.title: بحيرة الأصفر
asfar.summary_en: One of the largest bodies of water in the Gulf region, drawing migratory birds and nature lovers.
asfar.summary_zh: 海湾地区最大的水域之一，吸引着候鸟与自然爱好者。

najm-park.title: حديقة عين النجم
najm-park.summary_en: A park around the historic Ain Najm west of Al-Mubarraz, the most famous of Al-Ahsa's healing sulphur springs.
najm-park.summary_zh: 艾因奈杰姆公园位于穆巴拉兹以西，环绕历史悠久的艾因奈杰姆泉而建；这眼泉是哈萨最负盛名的硫磺疗养泉。

al-uqair.title: العُقير
al-uqair.summary_en: Saudi Arabia’s first seaport on its eastern coast, where desert sands meet the blue of the Gulf.
al-uqair.summary_zh: 沙特阿拉伯东部沿海的第一座海港，沙漠在此止步，与海湾的湛蓝相接。

jalaniyah.title: مسجد الجعلانية
jalaniyah.summary_en: An Uyunid-era mosque in Al-Battaliyah village, also known as the Battaliyah Mosque.
jalaniyah.summary_zh: 巴塔利亚村内一座乌尤尼王朝时期的清真寺，又称巴塔利亚清真寺。

qaisariyah.title: سوق القيصرية
qaisariyah.summary_en: A heritage souq over two centuries old, one of the oldest folk markets and a destination for crafts and local products.
qaisariyah.summary_zh: 可上溯 200 多年的老市集，海湾地区最古老的传统集市之一，手工艺与本地物产都在这里挑选。

jabri-mosque.title: جامع الجبري
jabri-mosque.summary_en: A Jabrid-era mosque in the Al-Koot district, alive with worshippers since the fifteenth century.
jabri-mosque.summary_zh: 库特区内一座贾布尔王朝时期的清真寺，自 15 世纪至今礼拜不辍。

abubakr-mosque.title: مسجد الشيخ محمد بن أبي بكر الملا
abubakr-mosque.title_en: Sheikh Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Al-Mulla Mosque
abubakr-mosque.title_zh: 谢赫穆罕默德·本·阿比·伯克尔·穆拉清真寺
abubakr-mosque.summary_en: A heritage mosque of some three centuries in the heart of the Al-Koot district, tied to the scholarly Al-Mulla family.
abubakr-mosque.summary_zh: 库特区中心一座约有 300 年历史的传统清真寺，与学者世家阿比·伯克尔·穆拉家族渊源深厚。

craftsmen-souq.title: سوق الحرفيين
craftsmen-souq.summary_en: A souq in the heart of historic Hofuf gathering artisans, their shops and a handicrafts academy, overseen by Al-Ahsa Municipality.
craftsmen-souq.summary_zh: 位于胡富夫历史城区中心、由哈萨市政局主管的一座市集，汇聚手工艺人和他们的店铺，并设有一所传授手工艺的学院。

women-souq.title: سوق النساء الشعبي
women-souq.summary_en: A traditional stall market in the South Al-Rifaa district of central Hofuf whose sellers are women of Al-Ahsa — hence the name — and one of the city's living folk-trade scenes.
women-souq.summary_zh: 胡富夫市中心里法阿南区的一座传统摊位市集，商贩都是哈萨的妇女，市集也因此得名，至今仍是城里鲜活的民间商贸一景。

lemon-farm.title: مزرعة الليمون الحساوي
lemon-farm.summary_en: A citrus farm where visitors pick the famous Hasawi lime (lomi) in season.
lemon-farm.summary_zh: 一座柑橘农场，应季时可以亲手采摘著名的哈萨青柠。

jawatha-park.title: منتزه جواثا السياحي
jawatha-park.summary_en: A green park beside the historic Jawatha Mosque, a destination for family outings.
jawatha-park.summary_zh: 与古老的贾瓦塔清真寺相邻的绿地公园，适合一家人出游。

king-abdullah-park.title: منتزه الملك عبدالله البيئي
king-abdullah-park.title_zh: 阿卜杜拉国王环境公园
king-abdullah-park.summary_en: A vast environmental park for walking and family outings.
king-abdullah-park.summary_zh: 一座面积广阔的环境公园，适合散步和家庭出游。

arbaa.title: جبل الأربع
arbaa.summary_en: Four adjoining conical hills south-east of Hofuf, a favourite camping and desert-trip destination.
arbaa.summary_zh: 胡富夫东南方向四座相连的锥形山丘，是远近闻名的露营与沙漠出游目的地。

ahsa-museum.title: متحف الأحساء
ahsa-museum.summary_en: The official regional museum; presents Al-Ahsa's history and antiquities across the ages.
ahsa-museum.summary_zh: 哈萨地区的官方博物馆，呈现这片土地各个时代的历史与文物。

al-asfar-and-national-park.zh: 阿斯法湖与国家公园路线

asfar_trail_intro_zh: 这条路线在绿洲以东，适合喜爱自然与沙漠出游的人：起点是一片森林，为保护绿洲不受流沙侵袭而栽；终点是沙丘间的一片湖，候鸟在此歇脚。前往湖边需要四驱车，还要有沙地驾驶经验，最好有向导同行。
asfar_trail_intro_en: A trail for nature lovers and desert explorers east of the oasis: it begins in a forest planted to shield the oasis from drifting sand and ends at a lake among the dunes where migrating birds rest. Reaching the lake requires a 4x4 and experience of sand driving; going with a guide is recommended.

seo_zh_published.title: 哈萨旅游指南——全球最大的绿洲
seo_zh_published.home.hero.lead: 哈萨——全球最大的绿洲。数千年来，水在沙下静静流淌，滋养着 250 多万棵椰枣树，生生不息。
